checkpoints.summary: Built the idempotency ledger + route fix for the photos purchase Stripe webhook (G-001, CP-011, CP-028). Mechanism: signature verification (server-side) -> service-role client -> claim insert into platform_webhook_events (provider=stripe, provider_event_id=event.id, processing_status=processing) -> process -> mark processed. Unique (provider, provider_event_id) is the data-layer idempotency: a duplicate event id observed with changed or repeated payload cannot re-claim. On 23505 the prior claim row is read: processed -> 200 duplicate (no reprocessing); incomplete -> resume (guards make it single-fulfillment). Row-level guards: completed/failed only from ['pending','processing']; refunded only when not already refunded — prevents double-fulfill and regression even across concurrent retries or resumed attempts. Switched createClient() -> createServiceRoleClient() because the ledger has no client policies and webhooks carry no user session (matches the three reference Stripe webhook routes). Processing errors surface 500 (Stripe retries; claim stays incomplete); 42P01 ledger-missing degrades gracefully. Changed files only inside the working set: route.ts (rewritten) + new __tests__/route.test.ts. No migration added/edited (reused existing platform_webhook_events table; nothing missing). Verification: jest 9/9 passed; full-repo typecheck completed with zero errors in this working set (991 pre-existing errors elsewhere in the dirty worktree are unrelated). CONFLICT RECORDED: this task's dispatcher mandates status 'implement' (QA/RELEASE verifies P0 security); control-plane validator enum only accepts active|blocked|completed, so agents:validate reports 'INTG-002: invalid status' — orchestrator should extend the enum or reconcile the status vocabulary.
